anim_ual.notes: Mesh-less GLB: the VRoid skeleton nodes (Root > J_Bip_C_Hips ...) + 84 clips (A_TPose dropped). Tracks: rotations for hips/spine/chest/upperChest/neck/head, shoulders, arms, hands, all fingers, legs, feet, toes; one translation track on J_Bip_C_Hips. In place: hips x/z locked to rest, y kept (crouch/sit/death/roll keep their height). *_Loop clips are seam-corrected (last key == first key). Hips y is absolute for a skeleton with hips at 0.887 m (the heroine); for another VRoid character multiply the J_Bip_C_Hips.position track y by (its hipsHeight / 0.887) when cloning clips (rotations need nothing). Swim clips are authored with y=0 as the water line (Swim_Fwd_Loop hips at -0.07 m, Swim_Idle_Loop hips -0.42..-0.32 m with the head above y=0): place the character origin on the water surface. Sitting_Idle_Loop / Driving_Loop put the hips at 0.52 m (seat height ~0.45 m): offset the character so the hips sit on the broom. Idle hips 0.85 m (knees soft); Roll hips range 0.04..1.11 m. PROPOSED GAME MAPPING — idle: Idle_Loop; walk: Walk_Loop; run: Jog_Fwd_Loop; sprint: Sprint_Loop; jump: Jump_Start (NinjaJump_Start for a sportier double-jump); fall: Jump_Loop (NinjaJump_Idle_Loop alt); land: Jump_Land (NinjaJump_Land for short landings); dodge: Roll; cast_throw: Spell_Simple_Shoot (OverhandThrow for a lobbed spell/charm); cast_raise: Spell_Simple_Enter (then Spell_Simple_Idle_Loop; add a procedural arm lift if an overhead raise is wanted — no overhead clip exists); cast_channel: Spell_Simple_Idle_Loop; cast_summon: Farm_PlantSeed (kneel and touch the ground); guard: Idle_Shield_Loop (enter via Shield_OneShot, break via Idle_Shield_Break); hit: Hit_Chest / Hit_Head (light), Hit_Knockback (heavy, ends standing via its own get-up); death: Death01 (LayToIdle to revive); sit_broom: Driving_Loop (seated, hands forward on the handle; Sitting_Idle_Loop as a hands-free alt); swim: Swim_Fwd_Loop (moving), Swim_Idle_Loop (treading); interact: Interact (PickUp_Table / Chest_Open / Consume for specific props); cheer: Yes (short nod + thumbs-up), Dance_Loop for a celebration loop; talk: Idle_Talking_Loop (Sitting_Talking_Loop when seated).

bgm_title.author: This project (original score)
bgm_title.notes: Title screen: the journey theme on solo piano, the bridge on flute with strings, then the whole theme on violins and flute; D major, 86 bpm.

bgm_sun.author: This project (original score)
bgm_sun.notes: Day field: the journey theme as a travelling song (strummed guitar, soft kit, flute, violins) with a tin-whistle interlude; D major, 116 bpm.

bgm_dusk.author: This project (original score)
bgm_dusk.notes: Dusk: a 3/4 evening tune on low whistle over fingerpicked guitar, accordion and cello, the theme head turned minor; E minor, 92 bpm.

bgm_night.author: This project (original score)
bgm_night.notes: Night: the journey theme told quietly on piano and celesta, the bridge on solo cello, a codetta with a far bell; D major, 66 bpm.

bgm_town.author: This project (original score)
bgm_town.notes: City of Magic: a waltz on the magic motif (accordion, mandolin, pizzicato, celesta), a street tune in E minor, a rooftop lift into C; G major with a Lydian C#, 132 bpm.

bgm_battle.author: This project (original score)
bgm_battle.notes: Ordinary fights: spiccato ostinato, toms and the journey theme head in B minor; hot layer bgm_battle_hot adds kit, horns, second violins and piano; 148 bpm.

bgm_duel.author: This project (original score)
bgm_duel.notes: Fran's spar: the magic motif as a duel figure in E Dorian (pizzicato, spiccato, celesta, frame drum); hot layer adds kit, horns and second violins when she flies; 152 bpm.

bgm_boss.author: This project (original score)
bgm_boss.notes: Named foes (elites, page guardians): the theme head in D minor on horns over marcato strings, timpani and low choir; hot layer adds kit, high strings and brass; 112 bpm.

bgm_final.author: This project (original score)
bgm_final.notes: Fran's recollection bout: her duel figure, the journey theme head in E minor, the whole theme in G major with the magic motif's runs; hot layer for her later movements; 160 bpm.

bgm_ending.author: This project (original score)
bgm_ending.notes: End credits: a traveller's song in B minor (low whistle, nylon guitar, accordion, cello) whose chorus becomes the journey theme in D major; 92 bpm.

bgm_flight.author: This project (original score)
bgm_flight.notes: Broom flight: the journey theme lifted to E major over driving piano, strings and kit, a breakdown and a soaring string line; 138 bpm.

anim_miko.notes: Second clip library on the anim_ual skeleton (mesh-less: Root > J_Bip_* incl. J_Adj eyes). 30 fps, LINEAR. Every clip keys every bone (rotation) + J_Bip_C_Hips.translation; hips y is absolute for hipsHeight 0.887 -> multiply by hipsHeight/0.887 per character exactly like anim_ual. In place (hips x/z sway only, mean ~0). *_Loop clips are seamless by construction (seam <0.05 deg). marks are seconds into the clip (release = the frame the spell leaves the hand). upperBodyOk = reads correctly when only spine-and-up tracks are layered over locomotion (UPPER_BONE). gohei: hold = right fist grips the wand with the player.js GOHEI_MOVE attach (never GOHEI_IDLE during these clips); hide = hands are open or both busy, hide or sheath the gohei. prop = what an NPC holds in handR/handL (game-side). Integration table: assets/_incoming/anim2/NOTES.md.
